text:
inc-bot: Paging oncall for high-severity alert: routing-policy-exception in smart-routing-service (eu region). 

ops-pager: @eva.nguyen you are oncall for smart-routing. Pager sent. 

eva.nguyen: I see the alert. Getting into the runbook now. Any customer impact notes?

mike.torres: Observed a sharp spike in failed policy evaluations starting ~10:02 UTC. Traffic is being looped across regions because rule evaluation returned error and fallback routing tries alternate region, which triggers the same rule.

sanjay.patel: Logs show a runtime exception in the policy engine: "InvalidExpression: undefined variable 'preferred_region'" — appears when evaluating dynamic route condition for multi-tenant customers.

lucy.sre: Confirming impact: requests to hosted inference are sometimes routed to wrong model variants (small -> tiny fallback) and some customers report generated outputs off-spec. Incident severity: P1.

eva.nguyen: Ok, step 1: isolate the policy. Can we disable smart-routing policy for eu-* quickly and fallback to static routing?

mike.torres: We can flip the routing-policy flag in config-management. Quick toggle: set `smart_routing.enabled=false` for region eu-west-1. Doing it now.

ops-pager: ACTION: mike.torres toggled smart_routing.enabled=false for eu-west-1.

sanjay.patel: After toggle, error rate drops but we still have in-flight loops for ~1 minute. Need to drain existing requests and ensure default model variant mapping applied.

eva.nguyen: Noted, start draining. Lucy, coordinate with CS for customers seeing bad outputs. SRE, watch latency and error graphs.

lucy.sre: Reached out to CS alert channel; queued list of affected customers (internal). Sending opt-in rollback for anyone hit.

mike.torres: Posting snippet of the exception stack for the policy engine: 
```
runtime/error: PolicyEvalError: InvalidExpression(\"undefined variable 'preferred_region'\")
  at evalRule (policy-engine/main.go:482)
  at handleRequest (smart-routing/router.go:219)
  at Serve(??)
```

sanjay.patel: Found the rule that triggers it. Config had a recent change that referenced `context.request.metadata.preferred_region` but for some legacy requests that field is missing. The evaluator does not guard for nil and throws.

eva.nguyen: Root cause hypothesis: new policy change rolled yesterday introduced an unguarded expression. That combined with certain edge customer requests created a fallback loop into other regions which re-evaluated the same expression -> repeated exceptions.

ops-pager: Handoff: @sanjay.patel and @mike.torres are primary for mitigation, @eva.nguyen remains incident commander. @lucy.sre owns customer comms.

sanjay.patel: Short-term mitigation completed: disabled smart-routing for eu region, restarted policy-engine workers to clear bad state. Confirming logs: no new InvalidExpression errors after restart.

mike.torres: Also applied a hotfix to the evaluator: wrap expression access with `exists()` guard in the engine and set default for missing context keys. Patch deployed to staging then rolled to eu canary.

eva.nguyen: Can we push hotfix to production now? Do we need canary window?

sanjay.patel: Canary ran for 5m with no regressions. Planning a controlled rollout to eu production in 10m. Will monitor for routing anomalies.

lucy.sre: CS update: initial message sent to impacted customers, offering scoped rollback and explanation. No customer data exposure. Some low-volume customers saw degraded outputs for ~7-10 minutes.

mike.torres: Rolling hotfix to eu-west-1 production now (policy-engine v1.12.3-hotfix). Command used: `kubectl set image deploy/policy-engine policy-engine=registry/redwood/policy-engine:v1.12.3-hotfix -n eu-prod`

sanjay.patel: After rollout, policy evaluations returned OK for previously failing tenant requests. Verified metric: policy_eval_exceptions dropped from 320/min to ~2/min.

eva.nguyen: Good. Re-enable smart-routing for eu in 5m and watch. Prefer to do phased re-enable (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

mike.torres: Re-enable step 1 (10%) done. No new loops. Re-enable 50% now.

lucy.sre: CS note: following up with customers impacted, asking for samples to validate quality.

ops-pager: Timeline update for postmortem: collect commits that introduced the unguarded expression, record rollout timeline, and propose a safer evaluator behavior (fail-safe default) + unit tests for missing context keys.

eva.nguyen: Incident declared resolved at our end pending postmortem. Leaving channel open for followups. Thanks team. :tada: 

sanjay.patel: Filing postmortem ticket RT-2467, tagging runtime and policy-engine teams.

lucy.sre: I'll include suggested customer comms and timeline.

inc-bot: Incident auto-closed (no alerts for 30m).
